{{Quote|This is our take on the traditional covado salad.|Dex's Diner menu, on its herd ship's bounty salad|<ref name="Menu" />}}
'''Covado salad''' was a traditional<ref name="Menu" /> [[Diet/Legends|vegetarian]]<ref name="Graveyard of Alderaan" /> [[Salad/Legends|salad]] made by the [[Sentience/Legends|sentient]] [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. The [[Foodstuff/Legends|dish]] could be eaten by Ithorians as well as other sentient beings. The food stand [[Ithor Delicacies]] served the [[Salad/Legends|salad]] on the [[Ithorian Herdship]] [[Bazaar (Ithorian Herdship)|''Bazaar'']].<ref name="Graveyard of Alderaan" /> [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]], an [[Restaurant/Legends|eatery]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], sold [[Herd ship's bounty salad]]s, its take on the traditional covado salad.<ref name="Menu" />

==Behind the scenes==
Covado salads were first mentioned in "[[Graveyard of Alderaan]]," a [[1991]] adventure supplement written by [[Bill Slavicsek]] for [[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]].<ref name="Graveyard of Alderaan" />
